Read a MO.Affinity Analysis export

Source: R/read.R
read_mst.Rd

read_mst() detects the type of export with mst_export_type() and reads its main table:

Usage

read_mst(path)

Arguments

path

Path to an .xlsx file exported from MO.Affinity Analysis, or a .moc or .nta project file.

Value

A tibble.

Details

  • MST Traces: read_mst_traces().

  • Capillary Scan: read_mst_capillary_scan().

  • Compare Results (Chart) and Dose-Response (Grouped and Flat): read_mst_dose_response().

  • Compare Results (Grid): read_mst_fit().

  • MO.Control (.moc) and MO.Affinity Analysis (.nta) project files: read_mst_traces().

Project files

MO.Control (.moc) and MO.Affinity Analysis (.nta) save projects as SQLite databases, which hold everything the Excel exports are made from. read_mst_traces(), read_mst_capillary_scan() and read_mst_metadata() read both kinds of project; read_mst_dose_response() and read_mst_fit() read MO.Affinity Analysis projects, which include the analysis. They return the same columns as for the Excel exports, with these differences:

  • An analysis_set column names the analysis set, as a project can hold several. A trace in more than one analysis set appears once for each. MO.Control projects have no analysis, so analysis_set, merge_set and included are missing, and run is named as MO.Affinity Analysis would name it.

  • Traces also have fluorescence_raw, the fluorescence in raw counts. fluorescence is normalised to the mean before the laser switches on, which is within about 0.2% of MO.Affinity Analysis's normalisation.

  • Measurement times are in UTC (the Excel exports use local time), and temperature is the measured temperature in degrees Celsius.

  • mst_power is a percentage, such as "40%", rather than a label such as "Medium", and excitation_type is not available.

  • The fits from read_mst_fit() are those saved in the project, which may differ from an export made at another time. They include each parameter's standard error as reported by MO.Affinity Analysis (*_std_error), and fixed lists any parameters that were fixed.

Fit curves (read_mst_fit_curve()) are not read from projects; calculate them with mst_fit() and mst_curve().

See also

read_mst_metadata() for the file-level header, and read_mst_fit() and read_mst_fit_curve() for the fits included in Compare Results and Dose-Response (Grouped) exports.

Examples

read_mst(tidymst_example("dppr10-cy5_dose-response-flat.xlsx"))
#> # A tibble: 48 × 25
#>    merge_set       run              capillary target target_concentration ligand
#>    <chr>           <chr>                <int> <chr>                 <dbl> <chr> 
#>  1 dPPR10-Cy5 Tray Run atpH-fl_50_…         1 atpH-…           0.00000005 dPPR1…
#>  2 dPPR10-Cy5 Tray Run atpH-fl_50_…         2 atpH-…           0.00000005 dPPR1…
#>  3 dPPR10-Cy5 Tray Run atpH-fl_50_…         3 atpH-…           0.00000005 dPPR1…
